name: echo-desktop-ops
description: Detailed, production-safe Echo Desktop operations API, verification, evidence, and release gating.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect, test, package, and gate Echo Desktop through one detailed API.
interface.longDescription: Provides bounded access to Echo Desktop source, Git, shared CLI history, Fleet Control, providers, MCP configuration, runtime processes, release artifacts, verification actions, redacted evidence reports, and deterministic release gating.
capabilities: Build, test, audit, and package verification
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $desktop-full-verification to inspect Echo Desktop, run the appropriate verification profile, and return an evidence-backed readiness decision.
